diya.query: Imperial College Mechanical vs Electrical vs Civil vs Chemical engineering A-level requirements comparison
diya.digest:

- **Mechanical Engineering:** typically **AAA–A\*AAA / A\*A\*A**; **Maths and Physics required**, often **A\*** in both; Further Maths recommended. *(Baidu Zhidao; Vision Academy; Dingshi)*
- **Electrical/Electronic Engineering:** typically **A\*AA–A\*A\*A**; **Maths and Physics required**; Further Maths strongly encouraged; Chemistry/Computing useful. May include an **online maths test/interview**. *(Vision Academy; Dingshi)*
- **Civil Engineering:** **Maths and Physics required**; exact grade range is **not clearly stated** in this week’s snippets. *(Vision Academy)*
- **Chemical Engineering:** **Maths and Chemistry required**; third subject may include Further Maths, Physics, Biology, Economics, or Business. Offers shown as **AAA–A\*A\*A**, so confirm exact course. *(Baidu Zhidao; Vision Academy; Dingshi)*
- **General Studies/Critical Thinking** are generally **not accepted**. *(Baidu Zhidao)*
